lastCommit.message: Five questions minted on the thinnest pages, each shipping with its proposed answer, and the last two unlinked Argenholm mentions wired

barRaise.topFinding: The BLOCK is still open: preview.json and search-index.json ship every DM-gated entity's real name to an anonymous fetch, live-reconfirmed tonight (Kazo, The Unchained, and 11 others), and a second independent leak path surfaced this run -- bold-autolinked prose (**Kazo**) auto-resolves to a real, unblurred href on public pages with zero gate coverage. release.ps1's own leak-check comment defines the leaking name as within its 'locked contract,' so the release pipeline validates the leak instead of catching it. Genuine progress landed this week: the original subtype/blurb/image leak is fixed and hard-gated, security-01/02 (allow-list, DM-session requirement) are closed, and v0.5's two deliverables both shipped -- but the milestone tracker and dashboard were never re-anchored to say so, and 281 commits since the last review put almost all of that volume into unrelated art/description work rather than closing the leak. Health dropped from 49 to 44 across 19 lenses, driven mostly by first-time full inspection of five lenses that had gone unmeasured or under-measured before (compliance-data-steward 64->32, cloud-edge-worker-cpu-budget 27->24) rather than fresh regression.

actions.title: Give worker.js a second gate keyed on data-surface paths (or route preview.json/search-index.json through a handler that filters by the same DM_PATHS/secret set at request time) instead of trusting build-time redaction alone, and add a release.ps1 check that GETs those two paths anonymously and asserts no gated name appears.

Withhold the n field (or drop the record entirely) for any entity where e.secret is true in the preview.json and search-index.json builders in web/build.mjs, then add a release.ps1 assertion that the name itself is absent from both surfaces for every URL in dm-paths.mjs.

Withhold secret entities from previewIndex entirely, or emit only a generic non-identifying stub, and add a release.ps1 check that diffs the anonymous preview.json name set against the authenticated one.
Add ctx to the fetch handler signature and change loadAnswersCached to return the possibly-stale snapshot immediately while kicking the rebuild into ctx.waitUntil.
Extract the shell CSS/menu/WHO_JS/SEARCH_JS into hashed /assets files with long-lived Cache-Control instead of inlining them on all 1,538 pages.
Register tools/kv-snapshot.mjs as its own scheduled task independent of ingest-answers-gnosis, and add a staleness check failing when the newest backup is over 36 hours old.
Compare each count in kv-snapshot.mjs against the previous day's snapshot and refuse to write on a >5% drop; raise KEEP past 7.
Extend /api/answers/export (and kv-snapshot.mjs) to include the pc:, forge:, hookpins, dmdismissed, and pin: KV namespaces.
Add a build-time line-count defect to build.mjs's own gate mechanism now that it has crossed 10,000 lines.
Re-anchor .project-context.json completion.pct/remaining against the shipped changelog entries and re-run write-dashboard-status.ps1.
Rename Gnosis's secret scanner and adopt the shared git-guard.ps1 pattern (Assert-GitSafe/Invoke-Git/Confirm-GitIntact) in push-to-github.ps1.
Move the git-guard call in push-to-github.ps1 to after git add -A so the secret scan actually inspects staged content.
Track whether the deploy path actually ran and stop printing 'Release complete' when the Cloudflare token is missing and deploy/live-checks were skipped.
Gate the dashboard write and Discord notify steps on a deployed flag that is only true after deploy actually ran and passed its checks.
Have discord-notify.ps1 write failure state to a log/status file instead of only Write-Host so a silent notify failure is visible after the fact.

Skip resolution in the bold-autolink inline() helper when the matched entity is secret (render plain text, no href), and extend the LEAK gate to scan rendered dist output for anchors pointing at dm-paths.mjs URLs, not just [[wikilink]] source syntax.
Add the ctx parameter to the Worker's fetch handler and move the snapshot rebuild and non-critical KV puts behind ctx.waitUntil.
Validate item in /api/shop-sell against the shop's real catalog before calling itemOf(), and cap distinct shop.items keys per shop.
Set an explicit daily or monthly LLM cost ceiling for Gnosis-attributed sessions and wire an alert when a day crosses it.
Add the four missing KV keyspaces (pc:, hookpins, dmdismissed, forge:) to /api/answers/export's body.
Add a KV/DO-backed failed-attempt counter with exponential backoff applied uniformly to every GATE_PASSWORD comparison site, not just /dm-login.
Split web/build.mjs along its own existing section seams, starting with the gating/redaction sections, before the next growth cycle.
Extract parseFrontmatter into one shared module imported by both web/build.mjs and tools/lore-audit/audit.mjs.
Add a console.error in every KV read/write catch block that currently discards the exception, at minimum on the answers/sticky/notes/shop-state/party/forge-queue paths.
Mark v0.5 DONE in PROJECT_SPEC.md, re-anchor completion.pct/anchored/milestone in .project-context.json, and declare or explicitly defer a v0.6 milestone.
Add a per-IP or per-character request-rate cap in front of /api/answer, /api/sticky, and /api/note.
Emit per-shop asset shards at build time (or cache the parsed catalog in the Worker) so a single-shop request stops parsing the full ~976KB catalog.
Extract one canonical esc() into a shared client-JS snippet the build injects everywhere and delete the 15 divergent local copies.
Default the DM board's unanswered-only filter to on (or bake status-first grouping into the build) so a fresh /questions-dm load doesn't paint 1,246 already-answered rows.
Add the same session-cookie check used by the create endpoints to /api/answer-delete, /api/sticky-delete, and /api/note-delete so a signed-in DM's delete workflow stops requiring a password prompt.
Route the globe/texture asset URLs through the assetV() content-hash helper instead of wall-clock BUILD_STAMP.
Record the known-good wrangler and Node majors and have release.ps1 fail loudly before deploying if the installed major differs.
Add a pinned requirements.txt covering numpy, scipy, and Pillow at the versions verified against the locked check chains.
Add the five missing status-JSON contract keys (lastReleaseAt, lastReleaseMessage, repoUrl, workTreeClean, stale) to write-dashboard-status.ps1's output.
Wrap release.ps1's body in a try/catch that posts a failure summary to Discord before re-throwing, so an unattended release failure is visible outside the console.
Add a commit+push step scoped to status/data/Gnosis.json so the public dashboard pill updates in the same release that bumps PROJECT_SPEC.md.
Split shop-data.json into one asset per shop and fetch only the relevant shard in shopData() instead of the whole catalog.
Require identity validation on /api/shop-sell regardless of tp so an unauthenticated npc-mode caller can't grow shopstate.items unbounded.

Extend the DM session-cookie check already used elsewhere to /api/shop-set, /api/answer-delete, /api/note-delete, /api/shop-rotate, and /api/gameday so the shared password isn't retyped on every mutating action.
Reuse the tmp+rename+readback write() helper already implemented in mint-question.mjs in forge-drain.mjs before it calls /api/forge-clear.
Apply the same rev/version guard used on pc: records to shopstate writes, or serialize shop mutations through a Durable Object.
Add a fixture-based node --test harness covering routeQuestion() and the LEAK checker.
Finish the server-side withholding fix for the preview.json/lore-page leak before starting another portrait or description batch.
Give items.json a licence object (publisher/licence/url/notice) and render the OGL notice on the Catalog page, matching the SRD spells/rules treatment.
Have shopOfTheDay/hookOfTheDay resolve the settlement pool against the live vault at post time instead of a hardcoded array, and skip/reroll if the resolved entity is secret.
Cap or paginate rotationPass so a single DM click or gameday advance processes a bounded slice of shops instead of scaling with total catalog size.
Combine shopstate and shopledger into one KV write for the sale path so a mid-sequence failure can't leave stock decremented with no ledger entry.
Cap request body size and validate the expected shape on POST /api/pc, matching the treatment already given to /api/answer, /api/sticky, and /api/note.
Route tools/statblocks/render.py and tools/route/build_route.py writes through the project's own tmp-file+os.replace helper.
